question: As per National Multidimensional Poverty Index report 2023, what is the poverty rate of India (2019-21)?
solution:
The correct answer is __**0.1496**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

 
• According to the **National Multidimensional Poverty Index (MPI) Report 2023**, India's poverty rate for the period 2019-21 was calculated to be **0.1496**.
 
• The report indicates a **significant reduction in multidimensional poverty** compared to previous years, reflecting improvements in various sectors such as health, education, and living standards.
